examples.en: Listen—even if I end up begging on the street, Luo Ziqun will never borrow money for you again.
examples.zh: 我告诉你，我罗子群就算到马路上要饭，也再也不为你借钱了。

examples.en: You're the one who can walk away from a marriage without looking back. Your sister must never divorce—not even if it kills her.
examples.zh: 要头也不回离婚的是你罗子群；打死也不能离婚的是你姐。

tags: 子君妹妹，婚姻反复，丈夫白光
